decisions.reason: A two-component resin injection unit launched only a year ago fits the firm's core application equipment line and needs time to recoup its development cost.
This second resin injection unit complements Product A as a product family variant and is still early in its lifecycle.
Automatic airless spray guns are a staple for industrial coating customers and serve the firm's established business.
Manual airless spray guns are a basic accessory that sells alongside the firm's pumps and costs little to maintain.
The air-assisted airless gun rounds out the spray gun range, and with its own website page it shows continued commitment.
A data logger supports the digitalization trend in coating equipment and adds value to the existing machines, so keeping it is sensible despite slightly higher uncertainty.
